morphology_definition: Raw RGBA MSE over the full grid; alpha > 0.1 for IoU and area. All three thresholds must pass. Development calibration is unchanged.
morphology_recovery: After first exit: 20 consecutive target states and >=95% of final 200 states in target. Never-exited trajectories are reported separately.
hidden_pair_return: Absolute hidden RMS <=10% of initial pulse distance for 20 consecutive steps and >=95% of final 200. Undefined for zero initial distance, as in the unperturbed control.
hidden_pca: Same hidden-only PCA for every branch of each model/replica. First temporal half fits PCA/scales; second half sets a q99 residual threshold for projection diagnostics. Residual and explained variance are not used to classify latent-regime recovery.
reference_stationarity: Pre-reference mean shift <=1 radius and speed ratio 0.5-2. These short-window checks are heuristics, not hypothesis tests.
recovery_time: Delay from pulse, conditional on observed sustained recovery after exit; unrecovered trajectories are counted, not assigned zero recovery time.
uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals over endpoint-eligible rollout replicas; numerical failures are nonreturns. Paired bootstrap and exact McNemar on common eligible IDs; Holm correction across binary comparisons within this morphology/checkpoint pair.
scope: One checkpoint pair; rollout replicas are not independent trainings. Morphologies are not pooled. Raw latent distances may differ in scale across trained models.
figures: Medians and IQR of finite replicas; missing/numerically diverged values are not imputed. PCA geometry alone does not prove an attractor or latent-regime recovery.
